messages.subject: Falcon - board minutes for the 9th
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Can you let me have the draft board minutes approving the acquisition for our meeting tomorrow afternoon? I'll arrange for them to be tabled and will get the SPA and ancillaries executed once approved. Assume completion the following day.

Richard Calloway
General Counsel, Bracken Group plc
